notes: Personal themed reward packs draw 3–5 prizes with replacement. The first draw uses eligible uncommon-or-better prizes when available; otherwise it uses ordinary supplies. The remaining draws choose an eligible rarity then an item by weight. Every manufactured reward still requires actual team production of that exact output. Rare/epic, custom components and storage equipment remain single-item draws. Reviewed raw supplies and basic components use useful batch sizes up to 16. Explicit branch-achievement quests award one Mayhem Cube instead of a pack, preserving the original outer claim ID and personal ownership. Plastic and HDPE remain excluded.
